details.reason: Withhold after independent risk audit (learner-critical-answer): Indonesian menemukan correctly expresses “to find” as obtain/discover. Malaysian menemui has a dictionary sense of finding, but its primary learner-relevant senses include meeting, visiting, or encountering a person; Malaysian Malay uses menemukan more clearly for finding something sought. Presenting menemui as the straightforward Malaysian equivalent creates a material false-friend risk. Retain outside promotion pending a vetted correction and fresh current clearance.
